snippet.title: Dredge - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Dredge is a horror single-player fishing adventure with an evil tone. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and dredge the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and get to the bottom of a dark secret in the open sea. Dredge is available now on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, Nintendo Switch, and PC.

#IGN #Gaming #Dredge
